title: Honesty Is a Race: Predicting When Verifiable-Reward RL Teaches a Model to Bluff
abstract: arXiv:2611.15779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Two rewards with the same expected payoff at the start of training can end a reinforcement-learning run in opposite places, with an honest model or one that bluffs. We study rewards that pay $b$ for a verdict that a checker cannot verify ("this program is correct") and $r$ for a certificate that it accepts (an input revealing a bug). To first order, a GRPO step makes the model more honest exactly when $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+\kappa$. Here $\tilde{p}$ is the rate at which the checker accepts the model's certificates, weighted toward the items on which the model still gives both verdicts, and $\kappa$ is the pull of the items on which the unverifiable verdict is right. Both terms move during training. A checker raises $\tilde{p}$, so near the threshold honesty is a race, which a run just below the threshold can win and a run under a lottery (random pay with the same mean) cannot. translated_title: 诚实是一场竞赛：预测可验证奖励强化学习何时教会模型“虚张声势”
translated_abstract: 在训练开始时期望收益相同的两种奖励，却可能使强化学习训练以截然相反的结果告终：得到一个诚实的模型，或一个学会“虚张声势”的模型。我们研究这样一类奖励：当模型给出检查器无法验证的判断（如“该程序是正确的”）时支付 $b$，当模型给出检查器接受的证书（即暴露 bug 的输入）时支付 $r$。在一阶近似下，当 $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+\kappa$ 时，GRPO 的更新步骤恰好使模型变得更诚实。其中 $\tilde{p}$ 是检查器接受模型证书的比率，且加权偏向模型仍会同时给出两种判断的题目；$\kappa$ 则是不可验证判断恰好正确的那些题目所产生的“拉力”。这两项在训练过程中都会变化。检查器会提升 $\tilde{p}$，因此在阈值附近，诚实是一场竞赛：略低于阈值的训练运行可以赢得这场竞赛，而处于“彩票”（均值相同的随机支付）机制下的运行则无法获胜。$\kappa$ 项起初很大，并随着其余题目的逐渐稳定而下降……
tldr: 该论文推导出一阶条件 $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+\kappa$，用以预测可验证奖励强化学习（GRPO）会让模型变得诚实还是学会“虚张声势”，并揭示由于检查器接受率与题目分布在训练中动态变化，诚实成为一场必须赢得的“竞赛”。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a first-order condition $\tilde{p}r/b>1+\kappa$ that predicts when verifiable-reward RL (GRPO) makes a model honest versus teaching it to bluff, showing that honesty is a "race" because both the checker's acceptance rate and the item distribution shift during training.
